# Owned private seeded void consumer

A direct Object-bounded method formal seeds a private static void consumer with
contravariant input callback and fully closed sibling task. A public same-class
wrapper keeps the existing generic API. Source and immutable Fn/Factory-JAR
profiles retain original declarations, access flags, code and metadata. The
existing frozen observer checks callbacks, mutation, long flags, partial saved
results, task order, nulls, late casts, exact exceptions and sticky init failure.
Same-Code Signature controls and independent incorrect bodies must fail.
